x: Staker kept shoulder to shoulder in the lead, until about six miles or more, when D. Christie Murray, of Surrey W.C., came through the field with a determined and extraordinarily well-judged turn of speed.

Christie-Murray was mainly responsible, was well supported and drew the largest entry of the season. Christie-Murray having the advantage of knowing the course, which at times was more like cross country, soon took the lead.
Christie-Murray, the Surrey W.C. and Oxford University athlete, finished second, with A.
